The documents only show one Valtteri Bottas win: the 2021 Turkish Grand Prix (Document 1), where he finished first for Mercedes. Within the provided information, that is his first win from 2000 onward, so the season is 2021. Mercedes won the 2021 constructors' championship. The documents don't cover the constructors' standings directly, so this relies on my own knowledge of that result.

Note that in reality Bottas's first win came earlier, at the 2017 Russian Grand Prix, which is not in the documents. Mercedes also won the 2017 constructors' championship, so the answer is the same either way.

ANSWER: Mercedes
